claims.text_en: The unit is the Sala Daeng interchange: BTS Sala Daeng (S2, Silom Line, opened 5 December 1999, Bang Rak district, coordinates 13.72851 N 100.53413 E) plus MRT Si Lom (BL26, Blue Line, opened 3 July 2004), whose station sits under Rama IV Road at Sala Daeng Intersection where Si Lom Road begins. The two are connected by a covered elevated skywalk that also reaches King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital; OSM node-to-node distance is ~330 m, consistent with a <=450 m merge.

claims.text_en: Green 10 rests on Lumphini Park: 360 rai / 57.6 ha bounded by Ratchadamri (west), Rama IV (south) and Witthayu (east). The park's southwest corner at Ratchadamri x Rama IV computes to ~281 m from the MRT Si Lom node and ~428 m from the BTS node, and the park centroid ~512 m from the MRT node - all inside an 800 m catchment. The app's 37.2 ha equals ~65% of the park, consistent with a nearest-station Voronoi split that leaves the park's western/southern portion in this cell; but the split line is app-decided, so membership is partial.

question_answers.notes: Merged BTS Sala Daeng (S2, 1999) + MRT Si Lom (BL26, 2004), ~330 m apart node-to-node, skywalk-connected; anchor latitude matches the BTS station coordinate exactly. Unit sits in Bang Rak (MRT straddles Bang Rak/Pathum Wan).
Office-district everyday: noon lunch alleys, skywalk commutes, hospital and mall services at the door; after dark the strip turns to Patpong's market-and-bars economy.

Transport/food/nightlife/green highs all have named mechanisms: two merged metro lines, 593-food-count density anchored by office demand and Lalai Sap, Patpong as the dataset's real nightlife heart, and a majority-ish share of Lumphini's 57.6 ha inside the catchment.
Counter-view documented: Patpong's tout/scam economy (unposted-price shows, inflated bills, counterfeit goods, pickpocketing) - the same venues behind nightlife 10.
Weekday: 06:00-15:30 market, noon peak; evening: Patpong from ~18:00, peak ~20:00, stalls down after ~22:00; weekends quiet.
Walkability assets are structural: skywalk BTS-MRT-hospital, compact soi grid; guides advise walking over taxis at lunch. No sidewalk-width data found; no radius-to-time conversions used.
Tops (Silom Complex, ~280 m), Foodland (~130 m), ~20 convenience stores within 700 m, Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital on the skywalk (~410-516 m).
38,000/60,000 sits between the typical-guide 1-BR band (~22,000-35,000) and the luxury-skewed aggregator median (44,900). Plausible for station-adjacent stock; flagged as high versus guide medians.

37.2 ha most plausibly = western/southern Lumphini (281-512 m from MRT Si Lom node; ~65% of 57.6 ha), plus Dusit Central Park (2024) at ~128 m from the MRT node. Voronoi split through the park is app-decided - flagged partial.

Strong fit: car-free CBD workers, food-driven households, nightlife-seekers tolerant of the strip's seaminess. Poor fit: quiet-seekers, families avoiding adult-entertainment frontage, weekend-liveliness seekers.
Dusit Central Park opened 27 Sep 2024 in-unit; One Bangkok phased opening from Mar 2024 just outside the cell (Lumphini MRT side); Patpong Museum closed May 2023 (pre-window).
Outside-the-score: green 10 depends on an unverified park split; rent figures rest on snippet-level portals; scam economy invisible to amenity counts; anchor longitude unknown.

preview.text_en: The real interchange of the Silom CBD: BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Si Lom 330 m apart under one skywalk, Patpong at the station steps, the office-lunch alleys of Lalai Sap - and most of Lumphini Park's western edge inside the catchment.

guide_lead.text_en: Sala Daeng is the app's only merged BTS+MRT unit south of Siam, and the merge is physically real: a covered skywalk runs from BTS Sala Daeng (S2, 1999) over Rama IV to MRT Si Lom (BL26, 2004) and on to King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital. Food 10 and nightlife 10 have visible engines - the weekday Lalai Sap lunch alleys on Silom Soi 5 and Patpong's market-and-go-go strip 90-200 m from the platforms - and green 10 leans on Lumphini Park's west corner ~300-500 m east. The counterweights are the strip's documented tout-and-overcharge economy and a rent band (38,000/60,000) that sits above typical 1-BR guide medians.

strengths.text_en: A true merged interchange: two metro lines 330 m apart under one skywalk, extended to a major hospital - the strongest everyday-transport geometry in this researched comparison set.
Food and nightlife are not abstractions here: the Lalai Sap office-lunch market and Patpong's night market sit within a few hundred metres of the platforms, on opposite halves of the day.

tradeoffs.text_en: Nightlife 10 shares its address with Bangkok's most documented tourist-scam strip: unposted-price upstairs shows, inflated bills and touts are a real resident-adjacent externality, not just a tourist problem.
The stated rent (38,000/60,000) exceeds typical 1-BR guide medians (~22,000-28,000 near the BTS in early 2025); the figure is only defensible as station-adjacent or larger-unit stock.

day_night.text_en: The unit flips at roughly 18:00: office-lunch alleys close by mid-afternoon and Patpong's stalls and bars take the street until late; weekends quiet down across both halves.

within_area_variation.text_en: The Silom frontage (Patpong, Thaniya, Lalai Sap) is loud and commercial, while the Rama IV/park side (Dusit Central Park, MRT Si Lom exits, hospital skywalk) reads calmer and greener.

conditional_fit.text_en: Strong fit: office workers and frequent travellers who want car-free CBD living, a hospital skywalk, and street food at both ends of the day.
Poor fit: households wanting quiet evenings or family-oriented streets - the red-light frontage and its tout economy are unavoidable at the station steps.

uncertainties: rating green (10): 37.2 ha matches ~65% of Lumphini's 57.6 ha, and the park's SW corner is only ~281 m from MRT Si Lom, but the park-split is an app-polygon fact we could not verify; if the cell boundary runs west of the park, the rating's mechanism changes (sala-daeng-c07).
rating rent (1-> figures): 38,000/60,000 is above typical 1-BR guide medians and below the luxury-skewed aggregator median; both comparison sets are snippet-level commercial sources (sala-daeng-c11).
rating safety (7) / crowd (2): no unit-level statistics found; crowd-2 inference rests on the office-district drain pattern, not counts.
Anchor longitude not provided; all distances computed from OSM/Wikipedia station nodes.
Lalai Sap's exact extent differs between sources (Silom Soi 5 label vs travelfish GPS ~700 m WSW).
